samples.summary: Editable share view mounts SheetView without `onUndoJump`, so cross-tab undo is silently invisible there
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:300` renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={readOnly} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` with no `undoJumpTarget`/`onUndoJump`. `readOnly` there is `resolved.role === "viewer"` (shared-document.tsx:198), so an **editor**-role share link renders a fully writable sheet where Cmd+Z is enabled (worksheet.ts:5106 only bails when `this.readOnly`). When such an undo replays a step in another tab, `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` fires `onUndoTabJump`, SheetView forwards to `onUndoJumpRef.current?.()` which is `undefined` (sheet-view.tsx:1083), and the document silently changes a tab the user cannot see — exactly the failure mode the change exists to remove. The prop doc added in the diff (sheet-view.tsx:165-166) asserts the omission is "the read-only share view … undo is disabled", which is not true for the editor role; that comment is the thing to fix on the new code, plus wiring the share view's tab state to a jump target.

samples.summary: `onUndoTabJump` is never unregistered on teardown, unlike the `onRefusal` callback it copies
samples.evidence: `Worksheet.cleanup()` explicitly clears the sibling model-level callback — `packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:609`: `this.sheet?.setOnRefusal(undefined);` with the comment "The model outlives this view (a Sheet is reused across mounts), so a refusal fired after teardown would toast through a dead host." The new `Sheet.setOnUndoTabJump` (sheet.ts:1105) is registered by `Spreadsheet.onUndoTabJump` (spreadsheet.ts:681) but nothing clears it: `Spreadsheet.cleanup()` (spreadsheet.ts:976-979) only calls `worksheet.cleanup()` and drops selection callbacks. Wherever the invariant that comment records holds (a Sheet surviving a view teardown), a stale closure captured from an unmounted `SheetView` keeps `onUndoJumpRef` alive and can call `setActiveTabId` on a dead host. Fix belongs next to worksheet.ts:609 (also clear `setOnUndoTabJump(undefined)`).

samples.summary: `handleUndoJump` switches `activeTabId` without validating the tab, unlike the peer/comment jump paths
samples.evidence: The sibling jump handler validates first — `packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-detail.tsx:300-302`: `const ws = root.sheets?.[anchor.tabId]; if (!ws) return;` — before `setActiveTabId`. `handleUndoJump` (document-detail.tsx:160) calls `setActiveTabId(selection.tabId)` unconditionally. `resolveUndoSelection` derives the tab id from `root.sheets` keys only (yorkie-store.ts snapshotTabs), which is not the same set as `root.tabs`/`root.tabOrder` used by the render switch (document-detail.tsx:746-769) and `TabBar` (:774-777). A sheets entry with no `tabs` entry (orphan, or a `datasource`/`lakehouse` tab id) would switch the app to a tab the TabBar cannot highlight, or to a view that never consumes `undoJumpTarget`, leaving the user parked away from where they were with no selection shown.

samples.summary: `Spreadsheet.onUndoTabJump` silently no-ops if called before `initialize()`, unlike the other `on*` registrations
samples.evidence: `packages/sheets/src/view/spreadsheet.ts:681` is `this.sheet?.setOnUndoTabJump(callback);` — `this.sheet` only exists after `initialize()` creates it (spreadsheet.ts:94). Every other host registration survives pre-init because it lands on the always-constructed `Worksheet`: `onValidationError` → `this.worksheet.setOnValidationError` (:406), `onNotice` → `this.worksheet.setOnNotice` (:415). The current frontend caller registers after `initialize` resolves (sheet-view.tsx:1082), so it works today, but any other host (harness pages at frontend/src/app/harness/hunt/page.tsx:437, harness/interaction/page.tsx:352, visual/sheet-scenarios.tsx:702) that registers earlier gets a silently dropped callback with no error.

samples.summary: Second undo entry point bypasses `Spreadsheet.undo()`, so the two undo paths keep diverging
samples.evidence: `packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5108` (Cmd+Z) and :5122 (Cmd+Shift+Z / Cmd+Y) call `this.sheet!.undo()` / `.redo()` directly rather than `Spreadsheet.undo()`, which the toolbar uses (packages/frontend/src/components/formatting-toolbar.tsx:218,222). The diff adds `this.worksheet.revealActiveCell()` only to the `Spreadsheet` path; the keyboard path already does `this.render(); this.scrollIntoView();` — but it also does `this.updateFreezeState()` (worksheet.ts:5109/5123), which `Spreadsheet.undo()` still does not, so undoing a freeze-pane change from the toolbar button leaves the view's freeze state stale where the keyboard shortcut refreshes it. Consolidating both entry points on one replay helper would keep these in step.

finding.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:300` renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={readOnly} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` with no `undoJumpTarget`/`onUndoJump`. `readOnly` there is `resolved.role === "viewer"` (shared-document.tsx:198), so an **editor**-role share link renders a fully writable sheet where Cmd+Z is enabled (worksheet.ts:5106 only bails when `this.readOnly`). verdict.reason: Every element of the finding checks out in the repo. shared-document.tsx:300 mounts SheetView with only tabId/readOnly/peerJumpTarget — no undoJumpTarget or onUndoJump. readOnly is `resolved.role === "viewer"` (shared-document.tsx:198), so an editor-role share link gets a writable, multi-tab sheet (tab state at 200 and 304-325). Undo is enabled there: worksheet.ts:5106 only returns early when this.readOnly. When an undo replays a step from another tab, sheet.ts:5489-5491 fires onUndoTabJump, which sheet-view.tsx:1082-1084 forwards to onUndoJumpRef.current?.() — undefined in this mount (ref assigned from the optional prop at 248-249) — so the cross-tab jump is silently dropped and the document changes a tab the user cannot see. document-detail.tsx:762-763 is the only site that wires the new props, confirming the share view is an unupdated consumer of the new contract. The prop doc at sheet-view.tsx:162-168 asserting the omission is "the read-only share view … undo is disabled" is factually wrong for the editor role. This is in-lane (a contract/behaviour change with an unwired consumer outside the diff) and reachable; no guard makes it unreachable.

finding.summary: `onUndoTabJump` is never unregistered on teardown, unlike the `onRefusal` callback it copies
finding.evidence: `Worksheet.cleanup()` explicitly clears the sibling model-level callback — `packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:609`: `this.sheet?.setOnRefusal(undefined);` with the comment "The model outlives this view (a Sheet is reused across mounts), so a refusal fired after teardown would toast through a dead host." The new `Sheet.setOnUndoTabJump` (sheet.ts:1105) is registered by `Spreadsheet.onUndoTabJump` (spreadsheet.ts:681) but nothing clears it: `Spreadsheet.cleanup()` (spreadsheet.ts:976-979) only calls `worksheet.cleanup()` and drops selection callbacks. Wherever the invariant that comment records holds (a Sheet surviving a view teardown), a stale closure captured from an unmounted `SheetView` keeps `onUndoJumpRef` alive and can call `setActiveTabId` on a dead host. Fix belongs next to worksheet.ts:609 (also clear `setOnUndoTabJump(undefined)`).

verdict.reason: The absence is real. Repo-wide grep shows `setOnUndoTabJump` is only ever called with a defined callback (spreadsheet.ts:681 from sheet-view.tsx:1082); no site passes `undefined`. The private field `Sheet.onUndoTabJump` is assigned in exactly one place (sheet.ts:1108, the setter), and `Sheet` has no dispose/reset helper (grep for `public cleanup|dispose(|destroy(` under packages/sheets/src yields only view classes), so there is no indirect clearing path. Following the teardown chain — sheet-view.tsx:1366-1388 -> Spreadsheet.cleanup (spreadsheet.ts:976-979) -> Worksheet.cleanup (worksheet.ts:572-612) — the sibling hook IS explicitly cleared at worksheet.ts:607-609 with the quoted comment, while the new hook is not, confirming the asymmetry verbatim. The consumer offers no compensating guard: sheet-view.tsx:1082-1084 forwards unconditionally (no `cancelled` check) into document-detail.tsx:158-162 `handleUndoJump`, which lives in the parent DocumentDetail that survives a SheetView remount and calls setActiveTabId — a late fire reaches a live host and switches tabs under the user. Impact is narrower than stated (the Sheet is per-mount, spreadsheet.ts:94, so the practical window is an in-flight Spreadsheet.undo/redo at spreadsheet.ts:649-669 resolving into applyUndoSelection/sheet.ts:5490 after cleanup) but the teardown site left out of step is genuine, in-lane (registration/teardown invariant in code the diff does not show), and fixed by the one-liner next to worksheet.ts:609.
